$comment: Expected-contract manifest for extract-design-system output bundles. The converter validates a bundle's structure against this file and records the observed extractor marker. Update recognizedMarkers when a new, verified-compatible extractor version ships; add to incompatibleMarkers only for a version documented as breaking. DESIGN.md front-matter `version:` is the design-system CONTENT version and is NOT the contract marker.

contentVersion.note: provenance only; never used as identity or contract check

tokens.note: Top-level keys are either an allowed bucket or a `$`-prefixed metadata key (e.g. $description). Anything else is DTCG shape drift -> WARN, never hard-fail; tokens are still copied verbatim.

full.detect: all canonical dirs present; >=1 components/*.html present and catalogued

no-screenshots.detect: screenshots/ absent or empty; otherwise full
no-screenshots.note: screenshots-absent is the source default; no warning

components-only.detect: components + tokens + DESIGN present but AGENTS.md and/or eval/* missing; catalog+snippets regenerated
components-only.warnMessage: components-only bundle: prose/tokens may be reused from a prior run; proceeding best-effort

single-file.warnMessage: single-file bundle: building from canonical split files; design-system.full.md is ignored as a copy source to avoid double-embedding

unsupported.detect: no supported variant matches (e.g. tokens-only with zero component snippets)
unsupported.failMessage: not a component bundle: no supported variant matched (missing component snippets/catalog)
